assumptions.baud_rates: EXPLICIT ASSUMPTION: 8 standard rates; no baud constant exists anywhere in the 132896-byte image
assumptions.clocks: 16MHz is an in-image constant; 64MHz is the conditional computed SYSCLK from the previous PLL round, not a measured oscillator
assumptions.divisor_index: all 16 table indices are enumerated; the runtime value is not fixed statically
assumptions.sku_and_devicesn: enumerated explicitly; runtime values come from hwinfo

channel_maps.role: 8-byte index remap consumed through config slot +0x1a4

usart_brr.formula_B: q = clock // table[index]; N = (2*q + (baud >> 1)) // baud; BRR = (N & 0xfff0) | ((N & 0xf) >> 1)

limits: The channel maps are byte permutations; which physical sensor channel each index denotes needs a schematic or device.
0x2000a4c0 + 0x18c and param_1 + 0x18c share the same offset but have different base objects; static bytes do not prove they are the same field.
param_1[1] (baud) and param_1[9] (divisor index) are runtime values; no standard baud-rate constant appears anywhere in the 132896-byte image.
0x0800cd24() = 64MHz is a conditional computed value from the previous round, not a measured oscillator.
RCC 0x40021054 is a live register; which clock-source branch runs on hardware cannot be fixed statically.
No firmware executed; no device, account, API or network access.
